author: Ari Koslow
title: Andres Munoz earns save Thursday
desc: Andres Munoz earned his 12th save of the season on Thursday against the Orioles.
impact: Munoz did not allow a hit, but he was able to work around a pair of walks. He has logged a pair of saves so far this week, though his overall struggles to record clean innings have continued.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryan Woo tosses seven scoreless innings Thursday
desc: Bryan Woo allowed three hits over seven scoreless innings with nine strikeouts and one walk in a win on Thursday against the Orioles.
impact: Woo had allowed just two base runners on a pair of hits through seven scoreless innings. He started the eighth, but was removed following a hit and a walk. He was able to bounce back after struggling against the same Orioles lineup in his previous start.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bobby Witt Jr. (knee) goes for additional testing after Thursday's game
desc: Royals' manager Matt Quatraro told reporters that Bobby Witt Jr. went for additional testing on his injured right knee after Thursday's game.
impact: Witt was removed early on Thursday with discomfort in his knee. He is day-to-day heading into Friday when another update should be provided.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mike Trout (hamstring) hopeful for short stint on IL
desc: Mike Trout said he is hopeful it'll be a short stint on the injured list.
impact: Trout landed on the IL on Thursday. He does not hold a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Joey Bart traded to Braves
desc: The Braves acquired C Joey Bart from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for RHP Hunter Stratton.
impact: Bart will add extra depth behind the plate for Atlanta.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sandy Leon designated for assignment
desc: The Braves designated Sandy Leon for assignment.
impact: Leon loses his spot on the Braves 40-man roster. He will likely clear waivers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hunter Stratton traded to Pirates
desc: The Braves acquired C Joey Bart from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for RHP Hunter Stratton.
impact: Stratton spent the first three seasons of his career in Pittsburgh. He'll head back to provide them more relief depth.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trea Turner diagnosed with bruised right calf
desc: Trea Turner was removed from Thursday's game due to a bruised right calf.
impact: Turner was removed from Thursday's game after he was hit by a pitch. He'll continue to be further evaluated.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Pete-Crow Armstrong goes deep as Cubs outslug Rockies
desc: Pete Crow-Armstrong went 1-for-4 in a win over the Rockies with a solo home run and one walk.
impact: Crow-Armstrong has flashed his power stroke of late, homering in four of his last five contests. The outfielder has broken out of a disappointing start to the season in the Cubs lineup, carrying an .854 OPS with 15 home runs, 37 RBI, 45 runs scored, and 16 stolen bases across 75 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Dansby Swanson homers, steals base in win over Rockies
desc: Dansby Swanson went 1-for-4 in a win over the Rockies with a two-run home run and one stolen base.
impact: Swanson has provided mixed results at the plate of late, picking up hits in six of his last 14 contests. The shortstop remains one of many underperforming options in the Cubs lineup for manager Craig Counsell, slashing .176 with eight homers, 30 RBI, 40 runs scored, and seven steals across 71 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kyle Karros goes yard in loss to Cubs
desc: Kyle Karros went 2-for-4 in a loss to the Cubs with a solo home run.
impact: Karros has heated back up at the plate, registering hits in four of his last six contests. The 23-year-old continues to fight consistency issues at the plate, batting .249 with four home runs, 20 RBI, 33 runs scored, and two stolen bases across 71 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Hunter Goodman goes deep in loss to Cubs
desc: Hunter Goodman went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Cubs with a two-run home run.
impact: Goodman has heated back up at the plate, collecting hits in three of his last four contests. The 26-year-old remains one of the more streaky options in the Rockies lineup, carrying an .858 OPS with 21 home runs, 39 RBI, 46 runs scored, and five stolen bases across 69 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Drew Pomeranz released by Angels
impact: Pomeranz passed through waivers unclaimed after he was designated for assignment. He will be free to sign with another team.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan Porter officially optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Angels officially optioned Logan Porter to Triple-A Salt Lake.
impact: The roster move had been announced on Wednesday. Porter should see another opportunity later in the summer.
